item.title: 100 x 120mm pothole on pavement outside 3 Witley Lodge Close. Previously reported and fix applied has now dropped as there is a considerable void under the hole, 16th July

The fix has now disintegrated causing a void running beneath the footpath. It is a danger to anyone using the footpath as it is a trip hazzard . The repair will need to be more substantial this time please
